a2-review-5.R5.1 A dinner party:
Narrator: It's Saturday evening in Chicago. Tom and Lucy are having a dinner party at their apartment for Kate and their roommate Priya.
Lucy: I hope everyone likes curry! I picked up some rice on my way home, so there's plenty for everyone.
Kate: It smells amazing. How much chili did you put in?
Tom: Just a little. We didn't have many chilies, so don't worry!
Priya: Good, because I've had a headache all day. The pharmacist said I should drink more water, and I shouldn't look at my laptop for a few hours.
Lucy: Then you have to take it easy tonight. No studying!
Kate: Tom, I watched you on Brain Battle. How many questions did you get right?
Tom: Five out of eight. I still can't believe I said butter!
Kate: And Ana told me she wrote a practice essay for the TOEIC.
Tom: Yes, about organic food. It was really well organized. In my opinion, she's ready for the test.
Priya: Did you see Paulo's webinar about Brazil? I learned that Brasília was built in less than four years!
Lucy: Really? I didn't know that.
Kate: By the way, I wrote a post about dinner party shows on my blog. Tonight I'm a guest, so I'm going to give you a score!
Tom: Uh oh. After dinner, how about playing a game? I know a good one called GHOST.
Kate: No way! You always explain the rules in the middle of the game. You have to tell us all the rules at the beginning!
Lucy: Ha! And here's a life hack for dessert. To make the ice cream easier to serve, take it out of the freezer ten minutes before.
Priya: Was the ice cream made by Kate?
Kate: Of course! It was made this morning, with black coffee.
a2-review-5.R5.2 Can or can't?:
Narrator: Listen. Write each number in the correct column.
Narrator: Number one. You can pay at the front.
Narrator: Number two. You can't use your phone.
Narrator: Number three. You can start with any letter.
Narrator: Number four. You can't give a clue.
Narrator: Number five. You can take it with food.
Narrator: Number six. You can't drive after you take it.
Narrator: Number seven. You can buy it without a prescription.
Narrator: Number eight. You can't look at the other papers.
Narrator: Number nine. You can ask for a little help.
a2-review-5.R5.3 Dialogues:
Narrator: Dialogue one.
Pharmacist: Here are your pills. You must take one pill three times a day.
Priya: OK. Can I take them with food?
Pharmacist: Yes, it's a good idea to take them with a meal. But you can't drive after you take them.
Priya: How much do they cost?
Pharmacist: Your insurance covers them, so you don't have to pay anything.
Narrator: Dialogue two.
Host: Next question. Where was the Maracanã stadium built?
Tom: It was built in Rio de Janeiro.
Host: Correct! And who were many buildings in Brasília designed by?
Tom: They were designed by Oscar Niemeyer.
Host: Correct again! How many questions have you answered today?
Tom: I've answered six.
